concept.material: polished green soapstone and nickel-plated brass
concept.internal_detail: miniature rack-and-pinion steering gears and micro-springs
concept.button: a tiny sunken pewter button flush with the surface
concept.shell_mechanic: The smooth carved soapstone pebble parts laterally along an invisible equator, sliding its top and bottom stone shells apart
concept.emerging_parts: Four articulated legs and a long flat scaled tail
concept.signature_move: its broad flat head pivots sharply to the left on its neck pin and its internal tongue plate slides forward and retracts with a single click
concept.turkish: Mavi dilli kertenkele (surungen hayvan) — purussuz yontulmus sabun tasi cakil, parlak yesil sabun tasi ve nikel kapli pirinc
